rationale: With only 9 minutes remaining until the market close and mandatory liquidation, there is insufficient time for a meaningful move to develop. The stock has already stalled twice at its intraday high of $19.38 (near the prior day's low of $19.41), while strong intraday relative strength above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($19.19) conflicts with the broader market sell-off and negative earnings catalyst, making both long and short entries unfavorable on a risk-adjusted basis.
